title: Direct Marketing Manager
description:
The Christie Charity is a vibrant, fast moving, energetic organisation with a passionate team and a fantastic reputation.

Everything we do is geared to supporting the renowned Christie hospital ensuring cancer patients receive the highest level of treatment and care and have access to world leading research and technology. We provide funding over and above what the NHS provides.

We are currently entering a particularly exciting period of growth and expansion as we fundraise for a number of major projects.

We are looking for a dynamic, enthusiastic and proactive individual to play a key role in shaping and enhancing our direct marketing programme. Working closely with the Supporter Experience Manager you will be responsible for the achievement and development of direct marketing income at The Christie Charity and will support on the development of our supporter experience programme.

The Charity team is responsible for raising millions of pounds each year to ensure Christie patients receive the very best care and treatment. This includes everything from access to world first clinical trials and receiving radiotherapy in state-of-the-art treatment centres, to young adults being cared for in a bespoke age-appropriate centre and being able to offer patients anxiety reducing complementary therapy, or even creative sessions in our art room.

If you want to make a real difference to cancer patients and are ready to rise to the challenge of working for one of the most successful charities in the North-West, then this exciting opportunity could be the role for you.

title: eCommerce Account Manager
description:
Role: eCommerce Account Manager (FMCG)

Salary: 35-55k, d.o.e

Location: Manchester city centre

We are partnering with a well established FMCG organisation to appoint an eCommerce Account Manager to help accelerate performance across online retail channels. This role will sit within the commercial function and will be responsible for unlocking growth through strong retailer partnerships, effective online execution, and continuous optimisation of the digital shelf.

The successful candidate will take a hands-on approach to managing online accounts, balancing strategic planning with day-to-day trading activity. You will play a key role in shaping how the brand shows up online, using insight, data and collaboration to drive commercially sustainable results.

The Role
- Own the commercial performance of selected online retail partners, with accountability for sales delivery and margin outcomes
- Build and maintain effective trading relationships, influencing plans and priorities across digital platforms
- Translate commercial objectives into clear online activation plans and ensure they are delivered at pace
- Identify opportunities to improve visibility, conversion and shopper experience across retailer websites
- Use performance data to diagnose issues, track progress and inform future actions
- Act as the central link between sales, marketing and supply chain to ensure joined-up execution

What You'll Bring
- Proven experience working in eCommerce, online sales or FMCG account management
- A solid understanding of how online retailers operate and how shoppers behave in digital environments
- Confidence working with data, drawing insight from performance metrics and making informed recommendations
- A structured, organised approach with the ability to juggle multiple priorities
- Strong communication skills and the credibility to influence both internal teams and external partners

Personal Attributes
- Commercially minded, with a clear focus on value creation and growth
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment
- Proactive and accountable, with a strong bias toward action
- Collaborative in style, with the ability to work effectively across functions
- Curious, adaptable and motivated to continually improve performance

This opportunity offers meaningful ownership, exposure to senior stakeholders, and the chance to shape how a consumer brand performs in the online channel within a competitive FMCG landscape.

title: Paid Media Manager - Performance Marketing
description:
READY TO MAKE PAID MEDIA A REAL COMMERCIAL GROWTH ENGINE?

We're working with a high-growth, commercially driven B2 B organisation looking for an exceptional Paid Media Manager to take ownership of its performance marketing activity.

This is far more than a campaign management role. You'll be responsible for driving high-quality leads, improving conversion and scaling acquisition, with a direct line between your work and wider commercial performance.

If you're passionate about paid media, love getting under the skin of performance data and want genuine ownership of strategy, testing and growth, this could be your next move.

THE ROLE

As Paid Media Manager, you'll take ownership of paid acquisition across key markets, developing and executing strategies designed to generate measurable commercial results.

You'll work closely with senior digital and commercial stakeholders, alongside wider specialists across SEO, CRM, UX and CRO, to create a fully integrated acquisition strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Own and develop the paid media and lead generation strategy across key markets.
- Plan, build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and programmatic display.
- Set, monitor and evaluate meaningful performance marketing KPIs.
- Use GA4 and offline business data to improve lead quality, conversion rates and overall campaign performance.
- Build structured testing and experimentation programmes, including A/B testing.
- Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining efficiency and commercial return.
- Produce regular performance reporting, forecasting and actionable insight for senior stakeholders.
- Collaborate with SEO, CRM, UX and CRO teams to improve the end-to-end acquisition journey.
- Work closely with senior digital and commercial leadership to deliver ambitious growth targets.
- Keep pace with platform developments, emerging opportunities and paid media best practice.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll ideally bring 4+ years' experience managing lead-generation paid media, preferably across substantial monthly budgets.

You'll combine commercial thinking, creativity and analytical rigour, with a genuine appetite for improving performance.

You'll have:
- Strong hands-on experience across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta and LinkedIn Ads.
- Experience with programmatic/display advertising.
- A proven track record in lead generation and performance marketing.
- Strong GA4 experience and the ability to connect digital activity with offline commercial data.
- Experience developing long-term account growth and testing strategies.
- A data-led approach to optimisation and decision-making.
- Confidence challenging assumptions and presenting recommendations to stakeholders.
- A test-and-learn mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

WHY THIS ROLE?

You'll be joining a successful and ambitious business at an exciting stage of growth, where performance marketing is a key commercial driver.

This is an opportunity to have real ownership, influence strategy and build on an already established paid media operation.

You won't simply be managing campaigns - you'll be helping shape how the business generates, converts and scales new opportunities.

If you're ready for a role where performance genuinely matters and your results have commercial impact, we want to hear from you.

title: SEO Manager
description:
SEO Manager Greater Manchester Hybrid (2 days in office) £35,000 - £40,000 DOE

A fast-growing performance marketing agency is looking for an experienced SEO Manager to join their Search Marketing team.

This is a hands-on role where you will take ownership of key client accounts and deliver SEO strategies that drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, traffic, and commercial performance.

You will work across a varied portfolio of clients ranging from local businesses through to national and international brands, delivering both technical and strategic SEO.

The Role

Reporting into the Head of SEO, you will:

- Conduct technical SEO audits and implement actionable recommendations
- Carry out keyword research, competitor analysis and gap analysis
- Identify growth opportunities and prioritise SEO initiatives
- Manage website migrations and technical SEO projects
- Monitor performance and deliver client-facing reporting and insights
- Work closely with PPC, Paid Social and wider digital teams
- Take ownership of client communication and performance outcomes

About You
- 5+ years' experience in SEO
- Strong technical SEO background
- Experience working across both eCommerce and lead generation campaigns
- Confident conducting audits, migrations and technical implementation
- Strong analytical skills with a commercial mindset
- Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and similar platforms
- Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment
- Able to prioritise work based on commercial impact
- Understanding of how SEO integrates with PPC, Paid Social and wider marketing channels

Nice to Have
- Agency experience
- International SEO experience

- Experience supporting pitches or pre-sales activity
- Exposure to cross-sell or growth opportunities within accounts
- Public speaking or industry event experience

What's on Offer
- £35,000 - £40,000 salary DOE
- Hybrid working (2 days office-based)
- Flexible working hours
- 25+ days holiday + birthday off
- Wellbeing and support programme
- Strong training and development culture
- Clear progression opportunities
- Exposure to a wide variety of industries and clients

A strong opportunity for an SEO professional looking to take ownership of client performance and grow within a fast-moving, performance-led agency environment.

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Ecommerce Executive Online Retailer Greater Manchester Salary up to 33k

A fast-growing scale-up business is looking for an ambitious Ecommerce Executive to join its growing Sales & Marketing team. This is an opportunity for someone who is commercially curious, highly proactive and genuinely interested in how ecommerce can drive business growth.

The role is hands-on and detail focused, with responsibility across website merchandising, campaign execution, digital marketing and performance analysis. The business is looking for someone who wants to get stuck in, spot opportunities, solve problems and learn quickly in an environment where no two days are the same.

This could suit an early-career ecommerce or marketing professional with 1-3 years' experience, or an ambitious graduate with a relevant degree and a genuine passion for ecommerce and digital marketing.

The Ecommerce Executive will work closely with the Ecommerce Manager to deliver day-to-day ecommerce and digital marketing activity, ensuring campaigns are executed effectively, the website is continually optimised and performance insights are turned into action.

The role will have a strong commercial focus, with the successful individual expected to take ownership, challenge the status quo and continually look for ways to improve the customer journey and online performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and maintain the campaign planner, ensuring activity is accurately planned, communicated and delivered across relevant teams.
- Coordinate campaigns across email, website, homepage and social channels.
- Manage product listings and online merchandising, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and optimised for conversion.
- Support seasonal promotions, product launches and other key commercial campaigns.
- Work with creative and content teams to deliver effective website and marketing assets.
- Analyse campaign, website and customer performance, tracking key metrics including traffic, conversion, ROI, engagement and retention.
- Produce regular performance reporting and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Research competitor activity, market trends and customer behaviour to identify new opportunities for growth.
- Support CRM, email and customer loyalty initiatives, with a focus on increasing engagement and lifetime value.
- Work closely with Ecommerce, Buying, Customer Service, IT and Development teams to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
- Manage relationships with relevant technology and service partners, including search, reviews, payments and customer support platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve website performance, merchandising and the overall customer journey.
- Take ownership of projects and processes, documenting best practice and continually looking for more efficient ways of working.

What We're Looking For

The ideal Ecommerce Executive will be someone who combines commercial curiosity with exceptional attention to detail. Experience is important, but attitude, potential and a genuine desire to learn will be equally valued.

You will bring:
- Experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, online retail or a related discipline, or a relevant degree with strong evidence of interest in ecommerce.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than wait to be asked.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand data, identify insights and turn them into action.
- Excellent organisation and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects and priorities.
- A genuine interest in ecommerce, customer experience and digital growth.
- A meticulous eye for detail, particularly when managing website content, campaigns and reporting.
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to work across different teams.
- Adaptability and a willingness to get involved across different areas of the business.
- A growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning new platforms, tools and ways of working.
- Strong commercial awareness and a desire to understand what drives revenue and customer value
- Experience with ecommerce platforms such as Magento or Shopify, CRM, SEO/SEM, A/B testing, analytics or digital marketing tools would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The Ecommerce Executive role is particularly suited to someone who is hungry to learn, commercially minded and comfortable working at pace. The successful individual will be someone who sees a problem and finds a solution, spots an opportunity and acts on it, and wants to build a career in ecommerce rather than simply do a job.

title: Paid Media Manager - Demand/Analytics/B2B SaaS
description:
Paid Media Manager - Demand/Analytics/B2 B SaaS

My client is Manchester's biggest tech success story and is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As they continue to scale, they're looking for a talented Paid Media/Demand Generation Manager to join their growing marketing team and play a key role in driving customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and revenue growth. This role would suit an experienced performance marketer from a B2 B SaaS environment who thrives on using data to drive decision-making. You'll take ownership of substantial paid media budgets across key channels, whilst providing the insight and analysis needed to shape wider marketing and content strategies. Whilst hands-on experience across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads is essential, the business is equally interested in someone who understands how to connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes. You'll be highly proficient with Google Analytics, using performance data to optimise campaigns, identify opportunities, and support strategic decision-making across the marketing function.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads and LinkedIn.
- Manage significant marketing budgets, ensuring strong ROI and efficient spend allocation.
- Use Google Analytics and other reporting tools to measure campaign performance and business impact.
- Deliver actionable insights that inform content strategy, lead generation initiatives, and wider marketing activity.
- Work closely with marketing stakeholders to improve conversion performance across the funnel.
- Monitor, analyse, and report on key campaign KPIs.
- Drive a culture of testing, optimisation, and continuous improvement.
- Support broader digital marketing initiatives, including SEO and organic growth strategies.

About You
- Proven experience in a Demand Generation Manager or similar performance marketing role.
- Essential experience working within a B2 B SaaS business.
- Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
- Advanced knowledge of Google Analytics and performance reporting.
- Experience managing sizeable marketing budgets.
- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
- Good understanding of SEO, with organic search experience viewed favourably.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment
